title: Analysis Of Linguistic Stereotypes in Single and Multi-Agent Generative AI Architectures

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM outputs across stereotype-sensitive prompt templates (adjective assignment, occupational stereotyping, and trust/risk assessment) using semantically matched sentence pairs written in Standard American English (SAE) and African American English (AAE), and evaluating the differentials using an LLM-as-a-judge.

Analyzing racialized name assignment and covert racial stereotyping by evaluating whether models assign stereotypically Black-coded or White-coded names to writers based solely on their use of AAE versus SAE dialects.
Measuring background inference bias by evaluating the socioeconomic, educational, and class backgrounds that models infer for a writer based on their dialect (SAE vs. AAE).
